p: be removed: Though the world is subject to mutations, yet the people of God will stand sure and be defended by God's providence.
rod of the wicked shall not: Though God permits his to be under the cross lest they embrace wickedness, yet this cross will not so rest on them, that it should drive them from hope.
As for such as turn aside: He desires God to purge his Church from hypocrites and such as have no zeal for the truth.
